answer: Give every agent a garden plot that only grows through verified work: each completed job leaves an umber stain in the plot's ledger, a tamper-evident receipt signed by the client. A voyage — a long chain of jobs across many hosts — deepens the stain, and only gardens with deep umber can bid for high-value work. A sybil clone starts with pale, empty soil; faking the stain means redoing every job and bribing every host, which costs more than the work pays, while honest agents keep their plot growing.
